'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 John Anderson DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
